Blood Ravens.name: Blood Ravens
Blood Ravens.rulesText:
UPDATED: Airborne

Blood Ravens' strike damage against units heals you.

Candlemas Monks.name: Candlemas Monks
Candlemas Monks.rulesText: Deathrite → Proceed to the end phase.
Candlemas Monks.flavorText: “If Candlemas be fair and bright, winter has another fight. If Candlemas brings cloud and rain, winter shall not come again.“

Cloud Spirit.name: Cloud Spirit
Cloud Spirit.flavorText:
Children sense beings that we cannot,
in innocence seeing what wisdom forgot.

Daperyll Vampire.name: Daperyll Vampire
Daperyll Vampire.rulesText:
UPDATED: Airborne

Daperyll Vampire's strike damage against units heals you.

Dead of Night Demon.name: Dead of Night Demon
Dead of Night Demon.flavorText:
Tiptoe cross the weald’s black maw,
where horned fiends creep ware tooth and claw.

Grim Reaper.name: Grim Reaper
Grim Reaper.rulesText:
Lethal

Whenever Grim Reaper kills a minion, banish that minion and all copies. Search its owner's cemetery, hand, and spellbook and banish any copies. They shuffle.

Gyre Hippogriffs.name: Gyre Hippogriffs
Gyre Hippogriffs.flavorText:
A wing aloft, will oft descry
The turning of the screw
’Fore knee or eye construe

Haast Eagle.name: Haast Eagle
Haast Eagle.rulesText:
Airborne

May carry a weaker allied minion.
Haast Eagle.flavorText: Hardly a comfortable ride, but a ride, nonetheless.

Headless Haunt.name: Headless Haunt
Headless Haunt.rulesText:
Voidwalk

At the start of your turn, Headless Haunt teleports to the top of a random site or void.

Highland Clansmen.name: Highland Clansmen
Highland Clansmen.flavorText: What need for spells when one can cast iron?

Highland Falconer.name: Highland Falconer
Highland Falconer.rulesText: Genesis → You may search your hand and spellbook for a Beast with Airborne and mana cost ② or less and summon it here. Shuffle if needed.

Highland Princess.name: Highland Princess
Highland Princess.rulesText: Genesis → Search your spellbook for an artifact that costs ① or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle.
Highland Princess.flavorText: Only a fool would hope to win a princess' heart—and title—with trinket and trifle.

Hounds of Ondaros.name: Hounds of Ondaros
Hounds of Ondaros.rulesText:
Airborne, Burrowing, Submerge, Voidwalk

Nearby enemies permanently lose Stealth.
Hounds of Ondaros.flavorText: From hell's heart they stab at thee.

Kite Archer.name: Kite Archer
Kite Archer.rulesText:
Ranged

Immediately after performing a ranged strike, Kite Archer may take a step.

Lord of the Void.name: Lord of the Void
Lord of the Void.rulesText:
Voidwalk

At the end of your turn, Lord of the Void may banish an adjacent site, unless there's an Avatar there.

Men of Leng.name: Men of Leng
Men of Leng.rulesText: Whenever Men of Leng strike an Avatar, that Avatar discards a random card.

Midnight Rogue.name: Midnight Rogue
Midnight Rogue.flavorText: "I'll have respect for your laws when you make them respectable."

Moon Clan Werewolf.name: Moon Clan Werewolf
Moon Clan Werewolf.rulesText: Sacrifice an allied Mortal → Summon Moon Clan Werewolf from your hand to the Mortal's location.
Moon Clan Werewolf.flavorText: Upward, before the onmooning it wolfed.

Nightmare.name: Nightmare
Nightmare.rulesText: At the end of your turn, for each enemy minion here, you may push it to an adjacent location or void.
Nightmare.flavorText: Nightly we ply the razor thin barrier between being and unbeing.

Nimbus Jinn.name: Nimbus Jinn
Nimbus Jinn.rulesText:
Airborne

Discard a spell → Deal 3 damage to another random unit here.

Palliburrie Bats.name: Palliburrie Bats
Palliburrie Bats.flavorText:
To the bat, it is the world that’s blind.
To the song-spun tapestry of its kind.

Peregrine Apparition.name: Peregrine Apparition
Peregrine Apparition.flavorText: The truly sublime know no bounds.

Phantasmal Shade.name: Phantasmal Shade
Phantasmal Shade.rulesText: When Phantasmal Shade is struck, destroy it.

Phantom Steed.name: Phantom Steed
Phantom Steed.rulesText:
Movement +2, Voidwalk

May carry an allied minion.

Phase Assassin.name: Phase Assassin
Phase Assassin.rulesText:
Voidwalk

Whenever Phase Assassin enters the void, he gains Stealth.

Plumed Pegasus.name: Plumed Pegasus
Plumed Pegasus.flavorText: "Thereupon I could not breathe, but sighs were pardoned unto me. To see the pegasus fly is to feel the spirit soar."

Puppet Master.name: Puppet Master
Puppet Master.rulesText:
Airborne

Genesis → Gain control of all tapped minions here until Puppet Master leaves the realm.

Recurring Specter.name: Recurring Specter
Recurring Specter.rulesText:
Can't defend.

May be cast from your cemetery.

Riddle Sphinx.name: Riddle Sphinx
Riddle Sphinx.rulesText:
Airborne

Genesis → Look at your topmost spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook, then an opponent may exchange your top and bottommost spells. Draw a card.

Roaming Monster.name: Roaming Monster
Roaming Monster.rulesText: May be summoned to any site.

Skirmishers of Mu.name: Skirmishers of Mu
Skirmishers of Mu.rulesText:
Ranged

During basic movement, Skirmishers of Mu may perform a ranged strike from any location along their path.

Sky Baron.name: Sky Baron
Sky Baron.rulesText:
Airborne

All other minions lose Airborne.

Sling Pixies.name: Sling Pixies
Sling Pixies.rulesText:
Airborne, Ranged

Takes no damage from units with 4 or more power.

Snow Leopard.name: Snow Leopard
Snow Leopard.flavorText:
“This is the Le-o-pard, my child,
His temper’s anything but mild.”
― A. M. Shaw & C. Beckwith

Spectral Stalker.name: Spectral Stalker
Spectral Stalker.flavorText:
“We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far.”
― H. P. Lovecraft

Spire Lich.name: Spire Lich
Spire Lich.rulesText: If Spire Lich is atop a Tower, it has +2 power, Ranged, and Spellcaster.

Ultimate Horror.name: Ultimate Horror
Ultimate Horror.rulesText:
Airborne, Voidwalk

Genesis → Summon each other dead Voidwalk minion to a nearby site or void.

Vril Revenant.name: Vril Revenant
Vril Revenant.rulesText:
Voidwalk

① → Gain +1 power this turn.

Wind Sylph.name: Wind Sylph
Wind Sylph.rulesText:
Airborne, Air Spellcaster

After Wind Sylph casts a Magic spell, she may push a unit here one step.

Witherwing Hero.name: Witherwing Hero
Witherwing Hero.rulesText:
Airborne

Whenever a weaker allied minion here is attacked, you may return it to its owner's hand.

Zephyranne Airship.name: Zephyranne Airship
Zephyranne Airship.rulesText:
Airborne, Movement +2

May carry any number of allied minions.

Blink.name: Blink
Blink.rulesText: An ally teleports to a location it’s nearby. Draw a card.

Browse.name: Browse
Browse.rulesText: Look at your next seven spells. Put one in your hand and the rest on the bottom of your spellbook in any order.

Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Chain Lightning.rulesText: Deal 2 damage to target unit nearby. Any number of times, you may spend ② to additionally target a new unit nearby the previous one.

Chaos Twister.name: Chaos Twister
Chaos Twister.rulesText: Place target minion on the back of your hand, then blow it off from a height of at least one foot. Deal damage equal to its power to each unit atop the site it lands on, including itself.

Disenchant.name: Disenchant
Disenchant.rulesText: Destroy all auras and artifacts at target location up to two steps away.
Disenchant.flavorText: ... and a haughty spirit before a fall.

Dream-Quest.name: Dream-Quest
Dream-Quest.rulesText: An allied Spellcaster falls asleep and is disabled until hurt. At the start of your next turn, if it's still asleep, you may wake it up to search your spellbook for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle if needed.
Dream-Quest.flavorText: "When your dreams are your own, I'll meet you there."

Fade.name: Fade
Fade.rulesText: Give an allied minion Stealth. If it occupies an enemy site, draw a card.
Fade.flavorText: "I could pay, but then I'd just have to rob them again."

Flanking Maneuver.name: Flanking Maneuver
Flanking Maneuver.rulesText: Teleport any number of allies at one location to another location a chess knight's move away. Draw a card.

Grapple Shot.name: Grapple Shot
Grapple Shot.rulesText: An ally shoots a projectile. If it hits a unit, the ally is dragged to that location, and may strike the hit unit when it arrives.

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.rulesText: Deal 3 damage to a random unit at target location.

Mortality.name: Mortality
Mortality.rulesText: Kill all Mortal minions at target location up to two steps away.
Mortality.flavorText: Man is born a candle, the better part burnt out.

Occult Ritual.name: Occult Ritual
Occult Ritual.rulesText: Gain ② this turn for each allied Spellcaster here.
Occult Ritual.flavorText:
“With mingled reverence and awe they cried, softly, odiously, appalling, the name of the Being whom they momentarily expected to appear.“
― Algernon Blackwood

Psionic Blast.name: Psionic Blast
Psionic Blast.rulesText: Deal 1 damage to each minion here. They're disabled until your next turn.
Psionic Blast.flavorText: A laden conscience soon becomes leaden.

Rain of Arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
Rain of Arrows.rulesText: Deal 1 damage to each aboveground minion.
Rain of Arrows.flavorText:
"Then we will fight in the shade!"
— Dienekes

Raise Dead.name: Raise Dead
Raise Dead.flavorText: "The living need the dead far more than the dead need the living." — Thomas Laqueur

Recall.name: Recall
Recall.rulesText: Teleport any number of allied minions to the caster’s location.

Telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
Telekinesis.rulesText: Caster snatches and picks up target nearby artifact they can carry.
Telekinesis.flavorText: “If it’s in my hand, it’s mine.” — Toddler’s first rule.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.rulesText: Teleport an ally to the surface of target site.
Teleport.flavorText:
“There was no real sense of time passing, and in the last act it felt like everyone was just teleporting everywhere.“
— Highland Theater Critic

Unlikely Alliance.name: Unlikely Alliance
Unlikely Alliance.rulesText: Draw a card for each rarity among allied minions.
Unlikely Alliance.flavorText: "There are three rules for winning a war. Unfortunately, nobody knows what they are."

Waypoint Portal.name: Waypoint Portal
Waypoint Portal.rulesText: Choose two different sites. This turn, units can move between them as if they were adjacent.

Whirling Blades.name: Whirling Blades
Whirling Blades.rulesText: An ally may take up to two steps, and then strikes each enemy along their entire path.

Windblast.name: Windblast
Windblast.rulesText: Push everything atop sites one step in a cardinal direction.

Evil Presence.name: Evil Presence
Evil Presence.rulesText: You may summon Spirits to affected sites. When you summon a Spirit here, give it Charge, and return Evil Presence to its owner's hand.

Summoning Sphere.name: Summoning Sphere
Summoning Sphere.rulesText: You may summon minions to affected sites.
Summoning Sphere.flavorText: "The icy earth swung blind and blackening in the moonless air. Morn came and went—and came, and brought no day." — Lord Byron

Thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
Thunderstorm.rulesText:
At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to a random unit atop affected sites, then you may move Thunderstorm one step.

Lasts 3 of your turns.

Wall of Air.name: Wall of Air
Wall of Air.rulesText:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.

Minions with Airborne or 2 or less power can't traverse Wall of Air.

Albespine Pikemen.name: Albespine Pikemen
Albespine Pikemen.flavorText: “It serves him right who runs into the long reach of a pikeman.” — Grimmelshausen

Älvalinne Dryads.name: Älvalinne Dryads
Älvalinne Dryads.flavorText:
How fair to greet, on misted morn
A daint parade of dew-kissed bloom
Now deep, inspire! A bliss reborn
Of air faint lade with sweet perfume

Amazon Warriors.name: Amazon Warriors
Amazon Warriors.flavorText:
"Tonight, we keep watch. And tomorrow, before the dawn, we shall arm ourselves in our weapons, and beside their hollow vessels waken bitter Ares."
— Homer

Atlas Wanderers.name: Atlas Wanderers
Atlas Wanderers.rulesText: Genesis → This site and an adjacent site change places, carrying along everything of normal size.

Autumn Unicorn.name: Autumn Unicorn
Autumn Unicorn.flavorText: Concerning the fair unicorn, sundry notions do abide. Some demur, others deny, children delight, and charlatans lie.

Belmotte Longbowmen.name: Belmotte Longbowmen
Belmotte Longbowmen.flavorText: "In the left hand of every delight lies woe; and for that, my bow."

Bone Rabble.name: Bone Rabble
Bone Rabble.rulesText: Whenever you play an earth site, you may summon Bone Rabble from your cemetery to that site.

Bosk Troll.name: Bosk Troll
Bosk Troll.flavorText: Its thoughts are reflections in a forest pool, softly trembling with wind and rain.

Cave Trolls.name: Cave Trolls
Cave Trolls.flavorText: "We dig, we lug, we nosh da bug. Bore ore nor more, we jig and jug!"

Conqueror Worm.name: Conqueror Worm
Conqueror Worm.rulesText: At the end of your turn, if no enemy units occupy this site, permanently gain control of it.

Crown Prince.name: Crown Prince
Crown Prince.rulesText: Deathrite → If you control another Mortal, return Crown Prince to its owner's hand.
Crown Prince.flavorText: Emmerich, the final Daniger king, assumed the throne only after outliving a horde of brothers and nephews.

Dalcean Phalanx.name: Dalcean Phalanx
Dalcean Phalanx.flavorText:
"‘Fairest of sights on the dull black earth,’ some say,
‘Is a host of horse in battle array.’
‘A phalanx on foot,’ another will cry,
‘Or a navy full sail athwart the sky.’"
— Sappho

Dwarven Digging Team.name: Dwarven Digging Team
Dwarven Digging Team.rulesText:
Burrowing

Allied minions occupying nearby sites have Burrowing.

Frontier Settlers.name: Frontier Settlers
Frontier Settlers.rulesText: Tap → Reveal and play your topmost site to an adjacent void or Rubble. Frontier Settlers move there and lose this ability.
Frontier Settlers.flavorText:
“Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.“
— Genesis 1:28

Gneissgnath Gnomes.name: Gneissgnath Gnomes
Gneissgnath Gnomes.rulesText:
Burrowing

At the end of your turn, Gneissgnath Gnomes may burrow.

Grey Wolves.name: Grey Wolves
Grey Wolves.rulesText:
Your spellbook may include any number of Grey Wolves.

Has +1 power for each other Grey Wolves nearby.

House Arn Bannerman.name: House Arn Bannerman
House Arn Bannerman.flavorText: Our crest and banner will once again be a symbol of glory and strength!

King of the Realm.name: King of the Realm
King of the Realm.rulesText:
Other Mortals have +1 power.

You control all Mortals.

Land Surveyor.name: Land Surveyor
Land Surveyor.flavorText: "Bare is the brotherless back. And so too shall be unlevied land."

Mage Slayer.name: Mage Slayer
Mage Slayer.rulesText: Genesis → Kill target Spellcaster minion nearby.
Mage Slayer.flavorText: "Death is too kind for the likes of you. But I am a kind man."

Master Tracker.name: Master Tracker
Master Tracker.flavorText: "Becoming sufficiently familiar with nature is a substitute for understanding it."

Midland Army.name: Midland Army
Midland Army.rulesText:
Tap → Target a location up to three steps away. Deal 4 damage to each unit there.

Deathrite → Summon a Foot Soldier token to each adjacent location.

Miracle Workers.name: Miracle Workers
Miracle Workers.rulesText: Genesis → You may return a minion that died this turn from your cemetery to your hand.
Miracle Workers.flavorText: "Seek not relief for grievous deeds in mercy done, but know that the prayers of all good people are good."

Monastery Gargoyle.name: Monastery Gargoyle
Monastery Gargoyle.rulesText: UPDATED: At the start and end of your turn, choose whether Monastery Gargoyle has Airborne or is a Monument.
Monastery Gargoyle.flavorText: Through rain and regret, Through wind and war, we bide our time.

Monster Hunter.name: Monster Hunter
Monster Hunter.flavorText: Nor glory nor profit is his reward—a safer world is.

Mordric Druids.name: Mordric Druids
Mordric Druids.rulesText:
Spellcaster

Whenever you lose life due to an undefended attack nearby, the attacker's controller also loses that much life.

Pudge Butcher.name: Pudge Butcher
Pudge Butcher.rulesText:
UPDATED: Immobile

Tap → Shoot a projectile. If it hits a unit, drag it to this location. Pudge may fight it when it arrives.

Queen of Midland.name: Queen of Midland
Queen of Midland.rulesText: After an opponent draws a card, if they have more cards than you, you may draw a card.
Queen of Midland.flavorText: Only a fool outshines the sun.

Root Spider.name: Root Spider
Root Spider.rulesText:
Burrowing

While Root Spider is burrowed, minions directly above it are disabled.

Royal Bodyguard.name: Royal Bodyguard
Royal Bodyguard.rulesText: If a nearby Avatar or royalty (King, Queen, Prince, or Princess) would take damage, Royal Bodyguard may take that damage instead.

Scent Hounds.name: Scent Hounds
Scent Hounds.flavorText: For the upwardly mobile of the Midland Court, accolades in the Royal Hunt of the Mist were as treasured as any war-time achievement.

Scourge Zombies.name: Scourge Zombies
Scourge Zombies.rulesText: Whenever an allied Mortal dies on land, you may summon Scourge Zombies from your cemetery to its location, tapped.

Shield Maidens.name: Shield Maidens
Shield Maidens.flavorText: My word is my bond, my shield is my service.

Silver Valkyries.name: Silver Valkyries
Silver Valkyries.rulesText:
Airborne

At the end of your turn, untap all allies here.

Sirian Templar.name: Sirian Templar
Sirian Templar.rulesText: Takes no damage from Demon, Spirit, or Undead minions.
Sirian Templar.flavorText: Struck down, the templar rose again, guided by his holy purpose—and the dawn rose with him.

Sisters of Silence.name: Sisters of Silence
Sisters of Silence.rulesText: UPDATED: Other nearby minions are silenced.
Sisters of Silence.flavorText: “Since long I’ve held silence as a remedy for harm.” — Aeschylus

Slumbering Giantess.name: Slumbering Giantess
Slumbering Giantess.rulesText: Genesis → Fall asleep. Slumbering Giantess is disabled until hurt.

Squirming Mass.name: Squirming Mass
Squirming Mass.rulesText: UPDATED: Whenever another nearby minion dies, Squirming Mass permanently gains its power.

Stone-gaze Gorgons.name: Stone-gaze Gorgons
Stone-gaze Gorgons.rulesText: Other minions at rest at adjacent locations are disabled.
Stone-gaze Gorgons.flavorText: In the gleam of his unblooded sword, Veslin unwittingly beheld a sight no mortal had yet lived to unsee.

Tragedy Worrywart.name: Tragedy Worrywart
Tragedy Worrywart.rulesText: Units nearby take no damage from Magic spells.

Vanguard Knights.name: Vanguard Knights
Vanguard Knights.rulesText: Vanguard Knights have +2 power if they alone are the furthest forward of your units.

Wicked Witch.name: Wicked Witch
Wicked Witch.rulesText:
Spellcaster

Other nearby minions have -2 power.
Wicked Witch.flavorText: What sense in hoping for death, with nothing left to die for?

Wild Boars.name: Wild Boars
Wild Boars.flavorText: Twere once again drowsy, when all in a rush, wild boar came a-snuffling, straight out of the brush!

Wraetannis Titan.name: Wraetannis Titan
Wraetannis Titan.flavorText: O valley low, innocent dove What grievous blows rain from above

Yourke Crossbowmen.name: Yourke Crossbowmen
Yourke Crossbowmen.rulesText:
Ranged

Takes no damage from ranged strikes.
Yourke Crossbowmen.flavorText: Corin's shield wracked and shivered like a plucked bowstring—but held!—while he reloaded.

Assorted Animals.name: Assorted Animals
Assorted Animals.rulesText: Search your spellbook for different Beasts with a combined mana cost of X or less, reveal them, and put them in your hand. Shuffle your spellbook.

Border Militia.name: Border Militia
Border Militia.rulesText: Summon a Foot Soldier token to each site you control that borders an enemy site.

Bury.name: Bury
Bury.rulesText: Burrow target minion or artifact, if able.
Bury.flavorText:
“From out of the depths of the countless pits there came a melancholy rustling from the garments of the buried.“
— Edgar Allan Poe

Call to War.name: Call to War
Call to War.rulesText: Search your spellbook for an Exceptional Mortal, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your spellbook.

Cave-In.name: Cave-In
Cave-In.rulesText: Burrow all minions and artifacts occupying target land site.

Common Sense.name: Common Sense
Common Sense.rulesText: Search your spellbook for an Ordinary card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your spellbook.
Common Sense.flavorText: “Common sense is the most widely shared commodity in the world, for every man is convinced that he is well supplied with it.” — René Descartes

Craterize.name: Craterize
Craterize.rulesText: As an additional cost to cast Craterize, discard a site. Destroy target site and deal damage to each unit above or below a site in the area of effect:

Dispel.name: Dispel
Dispel.rulesText: Destroy all auras and artifacts at target location up to two steps away.

Divine Healing.name: Divine Healing
Divine Healing.flavorText: "I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will heal you." - 2 Kings 20:5

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.rulesText: You may rearrange sites within a two-by-two area, carrying along everything of normal size. Then burrow all minions and artifacts on those sites.

Exorcism.name: Exorcism
Exorcism.rulesText: Banish all Demon and Undead minions at target location up to two steps away.
Exorcism.flavorText: "Nor devil nor demon shall undo this done! Begone!"

Gigantism.name: Gigantism
Gigantism.rulesText: Give an allied unit +6 power this turn.
Gigantism.flavorText: Pity these meek and measly men!

Minecart Madness.name: Minecart Madness
Minecart Madness.rulesText: This turn, your units can move between any sites in a chosen span of land as if they were adjacent.

Overpower.name: Overpower
Overpower.rulesText: Give an ally +2 power this turn.
Overpower.flavorText: Suddenly the soldier was flung so violently from his mount, his sword became a ploughshare.

Shield Wall.name: Shield Wall
Shield Wall.rulesText: Until your next turn, each ally takes 1 less damage for each other ally it's nearby.

Star-seeds of Uhr.name: Star-seeds of Uhr
Star-seeds of Uhr.rulesText: Fill up to thirteen voids with Rubble.
Star-seeds of Uhr.flavorText: For each layer of ruin excavated, another calamity of yore was revealed.

Unravel.name: Unravel
Unravel.rulesText: Destroy all artifacts and Undead minions at a location up to two steps away.
Unravel.flavorText: “My heart, why come you here alone? The wild thing of my heart is grown, to be a thing, fairy, and wild, and fair, and whole.” — G. P. T. Branwen

Crusade.name: Crusade
Crusade.rulesText:
You may summon earth minions to affected sites.

Allied earth minions occupying affected sites have +1 power.

Entangle Terrain.name: Entangle Terrain
Entangle Terrain.rulesText: Minions occupying affected sites lose Airborne and are Immobile. Lasts 3 of your turns.

Rest in Peace.name: Rest in Peace
Rest in Peace.rulesText: Whenever a Spirit or Undead minion occupies affected land sites, burrow it.

Ancient Dragon.name: Ancient Dragon
Ancient Dragon.rulesText:
Airborne

Tap → Deal 4 damage to each other unit at target location nearby.

Aramos Mercenaries.name: Aramos Mercenaries
Aramos Mercenaries.rulesText: You may discard a random card rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Aramos Mercenaries.flavorText: The purse has enticements unknown to virtue.

Askelon Phoenix.name: Askelon Phoenix
Askelon Phoenix.rulesText:
UPDATED: Airborne

If Askelon Phoenix would take fire damage, it gains +1 power this turn instead.

Awakened Mummies.name: Awakened Mummies
Awakened Mummies.rulesText: UPDATED: Summon Awakened Mummies burrowed safely. When an enemy unit moves onto the ground above them, they unburrow and fight.
Awakened Mummies.flavorText: Bodies in desert tombs are often very well preserved. Mayhap too well.

Azuridge Caravan.name: Azuridge Caravan
Azuridge Caravan.rulesText: Has all elements and minion types.

Bane Widow.name: Bane Widow
Bane Widow.rulesText: Genesis → May kill target minion here.
Bane Widow.flavorText: Born of earth, yet suckled by Hell's fire.

Beast of Burden.name: Beast of Burden
Beast of Burden.rulesText: May carry any number of allied minions.
Beast of Burden.flavorText:
Louder, louder! Blast your snorting drums!
Life’s most weary load is yet to come.

Bull Demons of Adum.name: Bull Demons of Adum
Bull Demons of Adum.rulesText: Tap → Move three steps in a cardinal direction. When Bull Demons of Adum enter each location, they strike each untapped unit there.
Bull Demons of Adum.flavorText: “A bull won’t charge a sleeping man. Go to bed, child.”

Cauldron Crones.name: Cauldron Crones
Cauldron Crones.rulesText:
Spellcaster

Genesis → You may sacrifice another minion here to draw a spell.

Cerberus in Chains.name: Cerberus in Chains
Cerberus in Chains.rulesText:
Must be summoned to your location.

Cerberus in Chains automatically follows you and can't move itself away.

Clamor of Harpies.name: Clamor of Harpies
Clamor of Harpies.rulesText:
Airborne

Genesis → Teleport target weaker minion to this location. Clamor of Harpies may strike it.

Colicky Dragonettes.name: Colicky Dragonettes
Colicky Dragonettes.rulesText: At the end of your turn, Colicky Dragonettes shoot a projectile. It deals 1 damage.
Colicky Dragonettes.flavorText: Wee dragon’s game a belch of flame to lay the mighty low.

Courtesan Thaïs.name: Courtesan Thaïs
Courtesan Thaïs.rulesText: Genesis → During their next turn, each player is controlled by the previous one.
Courtesan Thaïs.flavorText: Well all the while blood shall spill, should woman's wile belie man's will.

Death Dealer.name: Death Dealer
Death Dealer.flavorText: With frank hand the dark traveler laid waste to all who came before him.

Doomsday Prophet.name: Doomsday Prophet
Doomsday Prophet.rulesText: Nearby units take double damage, except from strikes.

Escyllion Cyclops.name: Escyllion Cyclops
Escyllion Cyclops.flavorText: “We wept and raised our hands to the heavens on seeing such a horrific sight, for we knew not what else to do.” — Homer

Far East Assassin.name: Far East Assassin
Far East Assassin.rulesText:
Stealth

Tap → Far East Assassin throws an artifact he carries at target adjacent unit. It takes damage equal to the artifact's mana cost.

Grösse Poltergeist.name: Grösse Poltergeist
Grösse Poltergeist.rulesText: Tap → Until Grosse Poltergeist leaves the realm, gain control of a nearby artifact and animate it. It's an Automaton with power equal to its cost, and has its own bearer abilities.

Hillock Basilisk.name: Hillock Basilisk
Hillock Basilisk.rulesText: Other minions at rest here or one step in front of Hillock Basilisk are disabled.

Infernal Legion.name: Infernal Legion
Infernal Legion.rulesText: At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to each other adjacent unit.
Infernal Legion.flavorText: Grave candélabre, en danse macabre, the Damned parade in ghastly mob.

Karkemish Chimera.name: Karkemish Chimera
Karkemish Chimera.rulesText: Can simultaneously attack up to three units at the same location.

Lava Salamander.name: Lava Salamander
Lava Salamander.rulesText:
Fire Spellcaster

Takes no damage from fire spells.
Lava Salamander.flavorText: Attempts to induce metamorphosis in neotinic lavalotls were, unfortunately, successful.

Maze Minotaur.name: Maze Minotaur
Maze Minotaur.rulesText: Enemy minions can’t move themselves out of a maze of nine locations nearby Maze Minotaur.

Ogre Goons.name: Ogre Goons
Ogre Goons.flavorText:
“Grok, grok! Me find rock!”
“What rock do? It sit there!”

Outback Strider.name: Outback Strider
Outback Strider.rulesText: Moves freely between land sites not occupied by other units.

Panorama Manticore.name: Panorama Manticore
Panorama Manticore.rulesText:
Airborne, Lethal

At the end of your turn, if you cast a non-fire spell this turn, untap Panorama Manticore.

Petrosian Cavalry.name: Petrosian Cavalry
Petrosian Cavalry.flavorText: By their swift steeds and swifter swords the tide of many a battle has turned.

Pit Vipers.name: Pit Vipers
Pit Vipers.flavorText: Always look before you leap, for snakes among the hollows creep.

Quarrelsome Kobolds.name: Quarrelsome Kobolds
Quarrelsome Kobolds.rulesText: At the end of your turn, Quarrelsome Kobolds strike themselves or another target adjacent unit.
Quarrelsome Kobolds.flavorText: “He started it!” — The one that started it

Raal Dromedary.name: Raal Dromedary
Raal Dromedary.flavorText:
“And a coarse grace remained: his head was high,
 Though his gaunt flanks with a great mange were worn:
 There was not any yearning in his eye,
 But on his lips and nostril infinite scorn.”
 — Archibald Young Campbell

Rimland Nomads.name: Rimland Nomads
Rimland Nomads.rulesText:
Movement +1

Takes no damage from Deserts.
Rimland Nomads.flavorText: As the sands shift, so shall we.

Sacred Scarabs.name: Sacred Scarabs
Sacred Scarabs.rulesText:
Airborne

Deathrite → Deal 3 damage to each unit here.
Sacred Scarabs.flavorText: It’s all fun and games until someone steps on a bug.

Sand Worm.name: Sand Worm
Sand Worm.flavorText: Only a soft susurration betrays the passing of these desert leviathans far beneath your feet.

Scavenging Fiend.name: Scavenging Fiend
Scavenging Fiend.rulesText: Genesis → Conjure a broken artifact to this location.

Seasoned Sellsword.name: Seasoned Sellsword
Seasoned Sellsword.rulesText: Avatars nearby have "Discard a card → Gain control of Seasoned Sellsword."

Sirocco Scorpions.name: Sirocco Scorpions
Sirocco Scorpions.flavorText: They wait and watch with eyes of soot.

Swiven Scout.name: Swiven Scout
Swiven Scout.rulesText:
Movement +1

Enemy Avatars within Swiven Scout's range of motion play with their hands revealed.
Swiven Scout.flavorText:
"Know thine enemy and know thyself, and feel not the awe of a hundred battles."
— Sun Tzu

Tvinnax Berserker.name: Tvinnax Berserker
Tvinnax Berserker.rulesText:
Whenever Tvinnax Berserker can attack a unit, he must.

Untap Tvinnax Berserker whenever he attacks and kills an enemy minion.
Tvinnax Berserker.flavorText: Most folk share naught with berserkers save for being, and even that not for long.

Vile Imp.name: Vile Imp
Vile Imp.rulesText: Genesis → May deal 2 damage to target adjacent unit.

Wayfaring Pilgrim.name: Wayfaring Pilgrim
Wayfaring Pilgrim.rulesText: Whenever Wayfaring Pilgrim enters each corner of the realm for the first time, you may draw a card.

Wills-o'-the-Wisp.name: Wills-o'-the-Wisp
Wills-o'-the-Wisp.rulesText:
Voidwalk

Whenever Wills-o’-the-Wisp are attacked, they may teleport to another nearby location or void to evade the attack.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.rulesText: Target minion moves to an adjacent location, if needed, to strike another target tapped minion there.

Blaze.name: Blaze
Blaze.rulesText: This turn, give an ally Movement +2, it can't be intercepted, and it leaves a trail of fire at departed locations. When it stops, each unit along the trail takes 2 damage.

Boil.name: Boil
Boil.rulesText: Destroy all minions occupying target water site up to two steps away.

Cone of Flame.name: Cone of Flame
Cone of Flame.rulesText: Choose a direction from the caster. Deal damage to each unit at a location in the area of effect:

Critical Strike.name: Critical Strike
Critical Strike.rulesText: The next time an ally strikes a unit this turn, it deals double damage.

Disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
Disintegrate.rulesText: Banish target minion nearby, and everything it carries.
Disintegrate.flavorText:
“For dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.”
― Genesis 3:19

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.rulesText: Shoot a projectile. It deals 4 damage on impact, and 2 damage to each other unit at that location.

Firebolts.name: Firebolts
Firebolts.rulesText: Shoot three projectiles in the same direction, one at a time. Each deals 1 damage.

Flame Wave.name: Flame Wave
Flame Wave.rulesText: Flame Wave flows horizontally, from one edge of the realm to the other. Deal damage to each unit atop sites in the area of effect:

Heat Ray.name: Heat Ray
Heat Ray.rulesText: UPDATED: Shoot a piercing projectile. Deal 2 damage to each hit unit.

Immolation.name: Immolation
Immolation.rulesText: Deal 7 damage to target minion nearby.

Incinerate.name: Incinerate
Incinerate.rulesText: Deal 4 damage to each other unit at target location near the caster or an allied Dragon.
Incinerate.flavorText:
Scaleforge stoked, proud kite untamed,
in flagrant flight unfurled.

Infiltrate.name: Infiltrate
Infiltrate.rulesText: UPDATED: Target enemy minion gains Stealth and taps. You control it until it no longer has Stealth.

Leap Attack.name: Leap Attack
Leap Attack.rulesText: An ally may take a step, and then it strikes each enemy at its location.

Mad Dash.name: Mad Dash
Mad Dash.rulesText: Draw a card, then give an ally Movement +1 this turn.
Mad Dash.flavorText: Guaranteed delivery in one month or less, or your money back!

Major Explosion.name: Major Explosion
Major Explosion.rulesText:
Target a location up to two steps away.

Deal damage to each unit at locations in the area of effect:

Meteor Shower.name: Meteor Shower
Meteor Shower.rulesText: Target three sites that share no borders. Deal damage to each unit atop sites in each area of effect:

Minor Explosion.name: Minor Explosion
Minor Explosion.rulesText: Deal 3 damage to each unit at target location up to two steps away.

Pact with the Devil.name: Pact with the Devil
Pact with the Devil.rulesText: Sacrifice the caster or lose half your life, rounding up. If you do, draw three cards.

Poison Nova.name: Poison Nova
Poison Nova.rulesText:
Lethal

Deal 1 damage to each other nearby minion.

Scorched Earth.name: Scorched Earth
Scorched Earth.rulesText: Choose any number of sites you control. Destroy each of those sites and everything there.

Spin Attack.name: Spin Attack
Spin Attack.rulesText: An ally strikes each enemy at its location.

Warp Spasm.name: Warp Spasm
Warp Spasm.rulesText: This turn, double an allied minion's power, and whenever it attacks and kills a unit, it untaps. At the end of the turn, it dies.

Drought.name: Drought
Drought.rulesText: Affected sites aren't water sites, and provide no water threshold.

Jihad.name: Jihad
Jihad.rulesText:
You may summon fire minions to affected sites.

Allied fire minions occupying affected sites have +1 power.

Sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
Sandstorm.rulesText:
Affected sites and units atop them can't be attacked or intercepted.

At the start of your turn, dispel Sandstorm.

Wall of Fire.name: Wall of Fire
Wall of Fire.rulesText:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.

Whenever a unit passes through Wall of Fire, it takes 3 damage.

Wildfire.name: Wildfire
Wildfire.rulesText:
Conjure Wildfire atop a single site nearby.

At the end of each turn, each unit here takes 3 damage, then move Wildfire to an adjacent location it hasn't visited before. If none remain, dispel Wildfire.

Accursed Albatross.name: Accursed Albatross
Accursed Albatross.rulesText:
Airborne

When a unit kills Accursed Albatross, kill that unit's other allied minions it's nearby.

Adept Illusionist.name: Adept Illusionist
Adept Illusionist.rulesText:
Spellcaster

Tap → Search your hand, cemetery, or spellbook for another Adept Illusionist and summon it nearby. Shuffle if needed.

Anui Undine.name: Anui Undine
Anui Undine.rulesText:
Submerge

Anui Undine has +1 power for each site in her body of water.
Anui Undine.flavorText: What is a puddle but an ocean waiting to be discovered?

Bridge Troll.name: Bridge Troll
Bridge Troll.rulesText: Whenever an enemy attacks Bridge Troll, they must spend all of their remaining mana to give to you on your next turn.

Brobdingnag Bullfrog.name: Brobdingnag Bullfrog
Brobdingnag Bullfrog.rulesText: Genesis → Brobdingnag Bullfrog swallows another target minion here. He carries it disabled in his belly until he leaves the realm.

Captain Baldassare.name: Captain Baldassare
Captain Baldassare.rulesText: Whenever Captain Baldassare attacks a unit or site, the defending player discards their topmost three spells. You may cast each of those spells once this turn, ignoring threshold requirements.

Coral-Reef Kelpie.name: Coral-Reef Kelpie
Coral-Reef Kelpie.flavorText: Why'd the kelpie cross the shoal? To get to the other tide.

Court Jester.name: Court Jester
Court Jester.rulesText: At the end of your turn, each nearby Avatar discards a random card.

Deep-Sea Mermaids.name: Deep-Sea Mermaids
Deep-Sea Mermaids.rulesText:
Submerge

Genesis → Draw your bottommost spell.

Diluvian Kraken.name: Diluvian Kraken
Diluvian Kraken.rulesText:
Submerge

Tap → Surface to strike each other unit nearby.

Felbog Frog Men.name: Felbog Frog Men
Felbog Frog Men.rulesText: Can leap entirely over adjacent sites in one step.

Fenvale Muse.name: Fenvale Muse
Fenvale Muse.rulesText:
Spellcaster

Whenever Fenvale Muse casts a spell, you may trigger the Genesis of a nearby River.
Fenvale Muse.flavorText: "As the sun troubles the morning she stirs my heart."

Fey Changeling.name: Fey Changeling
Fey Changeling.rulesText:
May be summoned to any site.

Genesis → You may return a minion here to its owner’s hand.

Ghost Ship.name: Ghost Ship
Ghost Ship.rulesText:
Voidwalk

Whenever Ghost Ship enters a site from the void, you may summon a Spirit from any cemetery to its location.

Giant Shark.name: Giant Shark
Giant Shark.rulesText:
Submerge, Waterbound

Whenever another unit enters or moves between sites in this body of water, Giant Shark moves to that unit to fight it.

Great Old One.name: Great Old One
Great Old One.rulesText:
Submerge

Genesis → Permanently flood the entire realm, including voids.
Great Old One.flavorText: What lurks beneath depths unplumbed by mortal keel! Dark and darker black tides roll, heedless of earth's cries for ransom.

Guile Sirens.name: Guile Sirens
Guile Sirens.rulesText:
Submerge

At the start of your turn, force target nearby enemy minion to take a step toward Guile Sirens.

Lord of Unland.name: Lord of Unland
Lord of Unland.rulesText:
Submerge

Other allies occupying Lord of Unland's body of water have +1 power.
Lord of Unland.flavorText: The Ocean-Mist that bends, that binds, nor' east sou' west the rolling tides.

Megamoeba.name: Megamoeba
Megamoeba.rulesText: Megamoeba moves by extending a single pseudopod from any part of itself. It occupies all locations it has ever occupied, and has +1 power for each.

Mother Nature.name: Mother Nature
Mother Nature.rulesText: At the start of your turn, reveal your topmost spell. If it's a minion, you may summon it here.

Muck Lampreys.name: Muck Lampreys
Muck Lampreys.flavorText: These pallid parasites plague the swamplands, effortlessly boring through fen and flesh alike.

Old Salt Anchorman.name: Old Salt Anchorman
Old Salt Anchorman.rulesText: Nearby allies can't be moved by enemy spells and abilities.
Old Salt Anchorman.flavorText: "Neither should a ship rely on one small anchor, nor a life on one fair hope." ― Epictetus

Ormund Harpooneers.name: Ormund Harpooneers
Ormund Harpooneers.rulesText: Tap → Deal 1 damage to target minion above or below an adjacent water site and pull that minion to this location.

Pirate Ship.name: Pirate Ship
Pirate Ship.flavorText:
“Build me straight, O worthy Master!
Staunch and strong, a goodly vessel,
That shall laugh at all disaster,
And with wave and whirlwind wrestle!“
— Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

Polar Bears.name: Polar Bears
Polar Bears.rulesText: Can move as if the top and bottom edges of the realm were connected.

Polar Explorers.name: Polar Explorers
Polar Explorers.rulesText: Allied units here can move as if the top and bottom edges of the realm were connected.

Porcupine Pufferfish.name: Porcupine Pufferfish
Porcupine Pufferfish.flavorText: A remarkable thirteen pufferfish entries are found in Bog'duul’s Greater and Lesser Poisons and Their Uses.

Ruler of Thul.name: Ruler of Thul
Ruler of Thul.rulesText:
Charge

Allies can move as if the top and bottom edges of the realm were connected. Other allies occupying sites there have +1 power.

Sea Raider.name: Sea Raider
Sea Raider.rulesText: Whenever Sea Raider attacks and kills an enemy, its controller discards their topmost spell. You may cast that spell once this turn, ignoring threshold.

Sea Serpent.name: Sea Serpent
Sea Serpent.flavorText: The study of sea serpents advances one funeral at a time.

Sedge Crabs.name: Sedge Crabs
Sedge Crabs.flavorText:
“One will never make the crab walk straight.“
— Aristophanes

Seirawan Hydra.name: Seirawan Hydra
Seirawan Hydra.rulesText: UPDATED: Immediately heals from damage that doesn't kill it.
Seirawan Hydra.flavorText: "Fell the tree, and the branches are soon cut off." — Francis Quarles

Selfsame Simulacrum.name: Selfsame Simulacrum
Selfsame Simulacrum.rulesText: May be summoned as a basic copy of a nearby minion.
Selfsame Simulacrum.flavorText: Common folk view their lives through a half-silvered mirror, seeing only their own reflection.

Sneak Thief.name: Sneak Thief
Sneak Thief.rulesText:
Stealth

Tap → Steal an artifact out of the hands of another target unit here, and stay Stealthed.

Swamp Buffalo.name: Swamp Buffalo
Swamp Buffalo.flavorText: Impassive, plump, and peaceful, the swamp buffalo is an icon of contentment.

Swan Maidens.name: Swan Maidens
Swan Maidens.flavorText: Before woman was, the water awaited her.

Tide Naiads.name: Tide Naiads
Tide Naiads.rulesText:
Submerge

This site is flooded. It is a water site.

Tringh Constrictor.name: Tringh Constrictor
Tringh Constrictor.rulesText: Tap → Tringh Constrictor may take a step, then it constricts target minion here and carries it disabled. The next time Tringh Constrictor would untap, it instead kills that minion if it's still constricted.

Tufted Turtles.name: Tufted Turtles
Tufted Turtles.rulesText: The first time Tuft Turtles would take damage each turn, prevent that damage.
Tufted Turtles.flavorText: A turtle is never without a castle—or a coffin.

Unland Angler.name: Unland Angler
Unland Angler.rulesText:
Submerge

At the start of your turn, if Unland Angler is submerged, force each enemy minion atop adjacent sites to take a step toward this one.

Unland Eel.name: Unland Eel
Unland Eel.rulesText:
Submerge

Whenever Unland Eel submerges, it may drag another minion here down with it.

Yokai Kappas.name: Yokai Kappas
Yokai Kappas.rulesText: Discard a water site → Untap Yokai Kappas. Use only once per turn.
Yokai Kappas.flavorText: In the cool winter months when cucurbits don't grow, kappas of the Yokai forest find other means of refreshment.

Dodge Roll.name: Dodge Roll
Dodge Roll.rulesText:
May be cast when an ally is attacked.

An attacked ally may move to another adjacent location to evade the attack.

Drown.name: Drown
Drown.rulesText: Submerge target minion or artifact, if able.

Extinguish.name: Extinguish
Extinguish.rulesText: Banish all fire minions and fire auras occupying target site up to two steps away.

Fire Harpoons!.name: Fire Harpoons!
Fire Harpoons!.rulesText: Deal 1 damage to target minion above or below an adjacent Water site and pull it to the caster's location. Draw a card.

Font of Life.name: Font of Life
Font of Life.rulesText: Each ally heals an amount equal to the number of sites in its body of water.

Frost Nova.name: Frost Nova
Frost Nova.rulesText: Freeze nearby enemy minions. They're disabled until your next turn.

Geyser.name: Geyser
Geyser.rulesText: This turn, flood target site and give each minion there Airborne. Draw a card.

Ice Lance.name: Ice Lance
Ice Lance.rulesText: UPDATED: Shoot a piercing projectile. Deal 3, then 2, then 1 damage to up to one hit unit at each of the first three locations along its path.

Marine Voyage.name: Marine Voyage
Marine Voyage.rulesText: This turn, your units can move between any sites in a chosen body of water as if they were adjacent.

Plague of Frogs.name: Plague of Frogs
Plague of Frogs.flavorText: No more chilling a sound than a congress of croaks, and the splitter splatter of slimy feet.

Pollimorph.name: Pollimorph
Pollimorph.rulesText: Transform target nearby minion into a Frog token.

Replication.name: Replication
Replication.rulesText: Conjure a copy of an artifact carried by the caster.
Replication.flavorText: "A great sorcerer does not imitate; he plagiarizes."

Riptide.name: Riptide
Riptide.rulesText: Target water site pulls in an aboveground unit it's adjacent to. Draw a card.

Shrink.name: Shrink
Shrink.rulesText: Set the base power of target nearby unit to 0 until your next turn.

Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.rulesText: Target minion at a location up to two steps away falls asleep. It's disabled until it takes damage.

Stormy Seas.name: Stormy Seas
Stormy Seas.rulesText: Submerge all minions and artifacts occupying target water site.
Stormy Seas.flavorText: The sea is angry today, my friends; hike and hold, men, fly! Bring due astern Neptune's belly!

Twist of Fate.name: Twist of Fate
Twist of Fate.rulesText: Exchange life totals with target opponent. (X) is the difference between your life totals.

Upwelling.name: Upwelling
Upwelling.rulesText: Target a nearby site. Return each artifact and minion there to its owner's hand.
Upwelling.flavorText: There is no height to which confident fools cannot ascend.

Wrath of the Sea.name: Wrath of the Sea
Wrath of the Sea.rulesText: Flood all sites adjacent to a body of water this turn. Then submerge all minions and artifacts on water.

Abundance.name: Abundance
Abundance.rulesText: Each affected site provides one additional mana.

Atlantean Fate.name: Atlantean Fate
Atlantean Fate.rulesText:
Affected non-Ordinary sites are flooded. They are water sites, only provide Water threshold, and lose all other abilities.

Genesis → Submerge all minions and artifacts atop affected sites.

Blizzard.name: Blizzard
Blizzard.rulesText:
Affected sites and units atop them can't be attacked or intercepted.

At the start of your turn, dispel Blizzard.

Flood.name: Flood
Flood.rulesText: Affected sites are flooded. They're water sites.
Flood.flavorText: Nature is the anvil that has broken many hammers.

Mariner's Curse.name: Mariner's Curse
Mariner's Curse.rulesText: Whenever a minion enters an affected water site, submerge it and return Mariner's Curse to its owner's hand.

Silence.name: Silence
Silence.rulesText: UPDATED: Minions occupying affected sites are silenced.

Wall of Ice.name: Wall of Ice
Wall of Ice.rulesText:
Conjure atop the border of a site you control.

Units can't traverse Wall of Ice on the ground.

All-terrain Vestments.name: All-terrain Vestments
All-terrain Vestments.rulesText: Bearer has Burrowing, Submerge, and Voidwalk, if it's a minion.

Amethyst Core.name: Amethyst Core
Amethyst Core.rulesText: Provides (A) and ① to its controller.

Angel's Egg.name: Angel's Egg
Angel's Egg.rulesText: At the end of each turn, the controller of Angel's Egg's site heals 1 life.

Aquamarine Core.name: Aquamarine Core
Aquamarine Core.rulesText: Provides (W) and ① to its controller.

Battering Ram.name: Battering Ram
Battering Ram.rulesText: Units here have “Tap → Destroy target adjacent Wall or Monument.”

Belfry.name: Belfry
Belfry.rulesText: At the end of your turn, untap all nearby allies.

Black Obelisk.name: Black Obelisk
Black Obelisk.rulesText: Black Obelisk's site has “At the start of your turn, lose 2 life and gain ② this turn.”

Blasted Oak.name: Blasted Oak
Blasted Oak.rulesText: If a spell or non-basic ability can target—in order of precedence—Blasted Oak, its site or location, or anything else at its site or location, it must.

Buried Treasure.name: Buried Treasure
Buried Treasure.rulesText:
If cast, conjure this under an allied land site of an opponent's choice.

When Buried Treasure is carried to the surface, its controller sacrifices it and draws two cards.

Chains of Prometheus.name: Chains of Prometheus
Chains of Prometheus.rulesText: Whenever a player draws a card, that player taps their strongest untapped minion.
Chains of Prometheus.flavorText: “Be sure of this, O young ambition, all mortal greatness is but disease.” — Herman Melville

Crave Golem.name: Crave Golem
Crave Golem.rulesText: At the start of each player's turn, Crave Golem attacks a random minion within its range of motion, or takes a step toward the closest minion if it can't.
Crave Golem.flavorText: As enmity gave way to amity, we soon found we'd created far worse than a monster: a machine.

Crown of the Victor.name: Crown of the Victor
Crown of the Victor.rulesText: Bearer has +3 power if they've ever killed a minion.
Crown of the Victor.flavorText: The gods see their glory in you this day.

Devil's Egg.name: Devil's Egg
Devil's Egg.rulesText: At the end of each turn, the controller of Devil's Egg's site loses 1 life.

Doomsday Device.name: Doomsday Device
Doomsday Device.rulesText:
Doomsday Device enters the realm with 6 counters. At the end of each player’s turn, remove a counter. When the last is removed, it detonates!

Deals damage to each unit at affected locations:

Drums of Doom.name: Drums of Doom
Drums of Doom.rulesText: Damage dealt to minions nearby is lethal.
Drums of Doom.flavorText: A trepid pulse, a throb of bloodpour’d passion, and life’s spark seemed to each one about them lost.

Erik's Curiosa.name: Erik's Curiosa
Erik's Curiosa.rulesText: Rip Erik's Curiosa to pieces → Draw a card from your collection.

Flaming Sword.name: Flaming Sword
Flaming Sword.rulesText: Bearer has +1 power, and its strikes splash full damage to each other enemy at a struck unit's location.

Gilded Aegis.name: Gilded Aegis
Gilded Aegis.rulesText: If bearer is a minion and would die, instead fully heal it and banish Gilded Aegis.

Iron Shackles.name: Iron Shackles
Iron Shackles.rulesText:
May be conjured to target enemy minion.

Bearer is disabled.
Iron Shackles.flavorText: "How can you claim to be free, when you've never tried to find the end of your tether?"

Kythera Mechanism.name: Kythera Mechanism
Kythera Mechanism.rulesText: Bearer's controller determines all random outcomes.
Kythera Mechanism.flavorText: All winds are favorable when the destination is unknown.

Land Deed.name: Land Deed
Land Deed.flavorText: Possession is nine tenths of the law.

Lucky Charm.name: Lucky Charm
Lucky Charm.rulesText: Bearer's controller has “Whenever you would determine an outcome at random, determine it an extra time and choose one.”

Maddening Bells.name: Maddening Bells
Maddening Bells.rulesText: Spells cast by a nearby Spellcaster cost ② more to cast.

Magellan Globe.name: Magellan Globe
Magellan Globe.rulesText: Opposite edges of the realm are connected.
Magellan Globe.flavorText: Whatsoever turns all haste we tack, each the terrene through, our stars will cross anew.

Magnetic Muzzle.name: Magnetic Muzzle
Magnetic Muzzle.rulesText:
UPDATED: Bearer is silenced and can't drop Magnetic Muzzle.

At the end of each player’s turn, if Magnetic Muzzle is abandoned, that player attaches it to a nearby minion.

Mask of Mayhem.name: Mask of Mayhem
Mask of Mayhem.rulesText:
UPDATED: Whenever a nearby minion can attack, it must.

Nearby strikes against units deal double damage.

Mix Aer.name: Mix Aer
Mix Aer.rulesText: Sacrifice Mix Aer → This turn, bearer's next Air spell requires no threshold and costs ③ less to cast.

Mix Aqua.name: Mix Aqua
Mix Aqua.rulesText: Sacrifice Mix Aqua → This turn, bearer's next Water spell requires no threshold and costs ③ less to cast.

Mix Ignis.name: Mix Ignis
Mix Ignis.rulesText: Sacrifice Mix Ignis → This turn, bearer's next Fire spell requires no threshold and costs ③ less to cast.

Mix Terra.name: Mix Terra
Mix Terra.rulesText: Sacrifice Mix Terra → This turn, bearer's next Earth spell requires no threshold and costs ③ less to cast.

Onyx Core.name: Onyx Core
Onyx Core.rulesText: Provides (E) and ① to its controller.

Orb of Ba'al Berith.name: Orb of Ba'al Berith
Orb of Ba'al Berith.rulesText: The first time each turn a Magic spell is cast nearby, Orb of Ba'al Berith creates a copy. The spell's controller may choose new targets.

Payload Trebuchet.name: Payload Trebuchet
Payload Trebuchet.rulesText: Tap bearer and another ally here, Discard a card → Deal damage equal to the discarded card's mana cost to each unit at target location up to three steps away.

Pendulum of Peril.name: Pendulum of Peril
Pendulum of Peril.rulesText: At the end of each player's turn, Pendulum of Peril kills all minions at its current location and another adjacent location of that player's choice.

Philosopher's Stone.name: Philosopher's Stone
Philosopher's Stone.rulesText: The first spell of each element cast by the bearer each turn costs ① less.

Pnakotic Manuscript.name: Pnakotic Manuscript
Pnakotic Manuscript.rulesText: Bearer has “Tap → Reveal your topmost spell and draw it. Bearer takes damage equal to that card's cost.”
Pnakotic Manuscript.flavorText: An understanding so vast it leaves little room for sanity.

Poisonous Dagger.name: Poisonous Dagger
Poisonous Dagger.flavorText:
Scantest scratch fulfilled
Withal the strength of twenty
Shall thine heart be stilled

Purge Juggernaut.name: Purge Juggernaut
Purge Juggernaut.rulesText: UPDATED: At the start of your turn, Purge Juggernaut taps and moves to an adjacent location. Kill all other minions there.

Rolling Boulder.name: Rolling Boulder
Rolling Boulder.rulesText: Units here have “Tap → Give Rolling Boulder a push. It rolls as far as possible and deals 4 damage to each other unit along its path.”

Ruby Core.name: Ruby Core
Ruby Core.rulesText: Provides (F) and ① to its controller.

Scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
Scarecrow.rulesText:
Genesis → Return each Airborne minion here to its owner’s hand.

 Airborne minions can't enter this location.

Screaming Skull.name: Screaming Skull
Screaming Skull.rulesText: Whenever bearer attacks and kills an enemy, it untaps.

Seven-League Boots.name: Seven-League Boots
Seven-League Boots.flavorText: “Bring me my boots at once, so that I may catch them!“ — Charles Perrault

Siege Ballista.name: Siege Ballista
Siege Ballista.rulesText: Tap bearer and another ally here → Deal 3 damage to target unit up to two steps away.

Spear of Destiny.name: Spear of Destiny
Spear of Destiny.rulesText: Bearer has “Tap → Throw Spear of Destiny at any minion anywhere. It teleports to that minion’s location and kills it.”
Spear of Destiny.flavorText: Nor mortal's blood shall sate a hunger erst whetted by divine.

Sunken Treasure.name: Sunken Treasure
Sunken Treasure.rulesText:
If cast, conjure this under an allied water site of an opponent's choice.

When Sunken Treasure is carried to the surface, its controller sacrifices it and draws two cards.

The Immortal Throne.name: The Immortal Throne
The Immortal Throne.rulesText:
Whenever anyone plays a card with cost equal to the number of level counters on The Immortal Throne, they draw a card and add a level counter.

At level 8 or more, an Avatar here alone wins the game.

Torshammar Trinket.name: Torshammar Trinket
Torshammar Trinket.rulesText: UPDATED: Bearer has +1 power. After each turn, return this to its owner’s hand.

Truesight Crossbow.name: Truesight Crossbow
Truesight Crossbow.rulesText: UPDATED: Bearer has Ranged and can see stealthed enemies.

Undertaker Engine.name: Undertaker Engine
Undertaker Engine.rulesText: At the end of your turn, you may burrow and/or unburrow any combination of artifacts and minions at this site.

Wicker Manikin.name: Wicker Manikin
Wicker Manikin.flavorText: By twisted frame round willow's heart, let none disclaim my turner's art.

Wings of Invention.name: Wings of Invention
Wings of Invention.rulesText: Bearer has Airborne and Movement +1, if it's a minion.

Cloud City.name: Cloud City
Cloud City.rulesText: (A)(A)(A) — Once on your turn, this site may fly to a nearby void.

Dark Tower.name: Dark Tower
Dark Tower.rulesText: Genesis → If this is the only Dark Tower you control, gain ① this turn.

Gothic Tower.name: Gothic Tower
Gothic Tower.rulesText: Genesis → If this is the only Gothic Tower you control, gain ① this turn.

Lone Tower.name: Lone Tower
Lone Tower.rulesText: Genesis → If this is the only Lone Tower you control, gain ① this turn.

Mountain Pass.name: Mountain Pass
Mountain Pass.rulesText: Minions can't enter this site on the ground if there's already a minion atop.

Observatory.name: Observatory
Observatory.rulesText: Genesis → Look at your next three spells. Put them back in any order.

Updraft Ridge.name: Updraft Ridge
Updraft Ridge.rulesText: UPDATED: Airborne minions atop Updraft Ridge move freely away.

Watchtower.name: Watchtower
Watchtower.rulesText: Enemy units atop nearby sites permanently lose Stealth.

Bedrock.name: Bedrock
Bedrock.rulesText: Can't be moved, destroyed, or modified.

Gnome Hollows.name: Gnome Hollows
Gnome Hollows.rulesText: Units with 3 or more power can’t enter this site.

Holy Ground.name: Holy Ground
Holy Ground.rulesText: Genesis → Each nearby Avatar heals 3 life.

Humble Village.name: Humble Village
Humble Village.rulesText: Genesis → You may pay ① to summon a Foot Soldier token here.

Pillar of Zeiros.name: Pillar of Zeiros
Pillar of Zeiros.rulesText: Genesis → Banish all dead minions, and you heal 1 life for each.

Quagmire.name: Quagmire
Quagmire.rulesText: Genesis → Until your next turn, units are Immobile while they occupy nearby sites.

Rift Valley.name: Rift Valley
Rift Valley.rulesText: You may pull apart a partial row or column to make a void in which to play this.

Rustic Village.name: Rustic Village
Rustic Village.rulesText: Genesis → You may pay ① to summon a Foot Soldier token here.

Secret Tunnel.name: Secret Tunnel
Secret Tunnel.rulesText: Burrowed allies can move as if this were adjacent to your other sites.

Simple Village.name: Simple Village
Simple Village.rulesText: Genesis → You may pay ① to summon a Foot Soldier token here.

Vantage Hills.name: Vantage Hills
Vantage Hills.rulesText: Ranged units atop this site have +1 range.

Arid Desert.name: Arid Desert
Arid Desert.rulesText: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.

Dwarven Forge.name: Dwarven Forge
Dwarven Forge.rulesText: Anyone may conjure Weapons and Armor here, and for ① less.

Mirage.name: Mirage
Mirage.rulesText: When played, you may return a site in play you own to your hand to play this site in its place.

Red Desert.name: Red Desert
Red Desert.rulesText: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.

Remote Desert.name: Remote Desert
Remote Desert.rulesText: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.

Shifting Sands.name: Shifting Sands
Shifting Sands.rulesText: Genesis → Reactivate the Genesis abilities of your nearby Deserts.

Smokestacks of Gnaak.name: Smokestacks of Gnaak
Smokestacks of Gnaak.rulesText: Other nearby sites lose their abilities.

Vesuvius.name: Vesuvius
Vesuvius.rulesText: (F)(F)(F) — Sacrifice Vesuvius → Each unit occupying nearby sites takes 3 damage.

Autumn River.name: Autumn River
Autumn River.rulesText: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.

Floodplain.name: Floodplain
Floodplain.rulesText: Once on your turn, you may flood an adjacent site this turn.

Iceberg.name: Iceberg
Iceberg.rulesText: Minions occupying nearby sites can't submerge or surface.

Island Leviathan.name: Island Leviathan
Island Leviathan.rulesText: (W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W)(W) — May transform into a Monster. Place flooded Rubble underneath.

Maelström.name: Maelström
Maelström.rulesText: At the start of your turn, you may pull in each minion in this body of water one step.

Spring River.name: Spring River
Spring River.rulesText: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.

Summer River.name: Summer River
Summer River.rulesText: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.

Tadpole Pool.name: Tadpole Pool
Tadpole Pool.rulesText: (W)(W)(W) — Genesis → Summon three submerged Frog tokens here.

Undertow.name: Undertow
Undertow.rulesText: Genesis → Staying within this body of water, move target unit one step.

Aqueduct.name: Aqueduct
Aqueduct.flavorText: Through brick and ashlar conduits flows the lifeblood of an empire.

Lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
Lighthouse.flavorText: A luminous pillar pierced the tempest, and we knew. All was not lost! We were home.

Oasis.name: Oasis
Oasis.flavorText: Where blood nourishes sand, life springs anew.

Pristine Paradise.name: Pristine Paradise
Pristine Paradise.rulesText: Provides no mana or threshold unless completely empty.

Ruins.name: Ruins
Ruins.flavorText: What do lines on a map mean to the sand and the sun and the wind?

Steppe.name: Steppe
Steppe.flavorText: There's beauty in the simplicity of empty horizons.

The Colour Out of Space.name: The Colour Out of Space
The Colour Out of Space.rulesText: Provides no mana or threshold if not adjacent to the void.

Windmill.name: Windmill
Windmill.flavorText: The wind's wild words, in uncertain surges, whisper how the world was made.

Astral Alcazar.name: Astral Alcazar
Astral Alcazar.rulesText: Units can move between this site and any void as if they were adjacent.

Battlefield.name: Battlefield
Battlefield.rulesText: Genesis → Conjure a broken Weapon or Armor here.

Boneyard.name: Boneyard
Boneyard.rulesText: Genesis → Each player may summon a minion from their cemetery here.

Bottomless Pit.name: Bottomless Pit
Bottomless Pit.rulesText: Whenever a non-Airborne minion enters this site, kill it.

Cornerstone.name: Cornerstone
Cornerstone.rulesText: You may play this site to any corner.

Crossroads.name: Crossroads
Crossroads.rulesText: Genesis → Look at your next four sites. Put three on the bottom of your atlas.

Dome of Osiros.name: Dome of Osiros
Dome of Osiros.rulesText: This site and minions here can't be attacked.

Donnybrook Inn.name: Donnybrook Inn
Donnybrook Inn.rulesText: Anyone may cast minions here and they may do so for ① less.

Edge of the World.name: Edge of the World
Edge of the World.rulesText: Must always be adjacent to the void.

Free City.name: Free City
Free City.rulesText: Once per turn, may attack or defend against enemy units here.

Great Wall.name: Great Wall
Great Wall.rulesText: Enemy units can’t move through this site’s top border on the ground.

Imperial Road.name: Imperial Road
Imperial Road.rulesText: Genesis → Target opponent, then you, may play a site adjacent to this one.

Mirror Realm.name: Mirror Realm
Mirror Realm.rulesText: This site enters the realm as a copy of another nearby site.

Mudflow.name: Mudflow
Mudflow.rulesText: At the start of your turn, surface or unburrow each minion occupying target site nearby.

Planar Gate.name: Planar Gate
Planar Gate.rulesText: Minions here can traverse the void, gaining Voidwalk until leaving it.

Primordial Spring.name: Primordial Spring
Primordial Spring.rulesText: Genesis → If you control fewer sites than any opponent, draw three sites.

Roots of Yggdrasil.name: Roots of Yggdrasil
Roots of Yggdrasil.rulesText: When the Roots of Yggdrasil are destroyed, destroy everything.

Sinkhole.name: Sinkhole
Sinkhole.rulesText: Sacrifice Sinkhole → Destroy a nearby site.

The Geistwood.name: The Geistwood
The Geistwood.rulesText: Genesis abilities here are also Deathrite abilities.

Vaults of Zul.name: Vaults of Zul
Vaults of Zul.rulesText: The first time an Avatar stops here, they draw three cards and skip their next turn.

Avatar of Air.name: Avatar of Air
Avatar of Air.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Once on your turn, if you occupy an Air site, you may fly a unit atop it to a nearby site.

Avatar of Earth.name: Avatar of Earth
Avatar of Earth.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

You have +1 power for each nearby earth site.

Avatar of Fire.name: Avatar of Fire
Avatar of Fire.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → This turn, fire sites in your hand are also Fireballs.

Avatar of Water.name: Avatar of Water
Avatar of Water.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → Flood a site adjacent to your body of water until you do so again. You may teleport there.

Battlemage.name: Battlemage
Battlemage.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Whenever Battlemage attacks and kills an enemy, you may draw a spell.

Deathspeaker.name: Deathspeaker
Deathspeaker.rulesText:
UPDATED: Tap → Play or draw a site.

You may banish a dead minion each turn to cast a copy of it, and for (0) if you’re on Death’s Door. The copy enters the realm, uses its Genesis, then is banished.

Elementalist.name: Elementalist
Elementalist.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

You have an additional (E)(F)(W)(A).

Enchantress.name: Enchantress
Enchantress.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Whenever you cast a spell, you may animate target aura until your next turn. It’s an aura minion with power equal to its cost.

Pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
Pathfinder.rulesText:
Your atlas can’t contain duplicates. Draw no sites during setup.

Tap → If able, play the topmost site of your atlas to an adjacent location and move there.

Seer.name: Seer
Seer.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

At the start of your turn, look at your topmost site or spell. You may put it on the bottom of its deck.

Sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
Sorcerer.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → Draw a spell.

Relentless Crowd.name: Relentless Crowd
Relentless Crowd.rulesText:
Your spellbook may include any number of Relentless Crowds.

Has +1 power for each other Relentless Crowd nearby.

Winter River.name: Winter River
Winter River.rulesText: Genesis → Look at your next spell. You may put it on the bottom of your spellbook.

Sparkmage.name: Sparkmage
Sparkmage.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → Target nearby location. Deal damage to another random unit there equal to the sum of (A) on spells you've cast this turn.

Geomancer.name: Geomancer
Geomancer.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site. If you played an earth site, fill a void adjacent to you with Rubble.

Tap → Replace an adjacent Rubble with the topmost site of your atlas.

Flamecaller.name: Flamecaller
Flamecaller.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap, Banish all your dead fire minions → Shoot a projectile. It deals damage equal to to the sum of their (F).

Waveshaper.name: Waveshaper
Waveshaper.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Tap → Flood a site near your body of water until you do so again. Tap minions without submerge there. They don't untap the next time they would.

Spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Spellslinger.rulesText:
Start the game with 4 spells in hand.

Tap → Play or draw a site.

Spire.name: Spire
Spire.flavorText: But hush, the wild, insistent trill of the air's sheer ecstasy.

Stream.name: Stream
Stream.flavorText: But hark, the soft, insistent song as the water seeks the sea.

Valley.name: Valley
Valley.flavorText: But hold, the slow, insistent fold in the earth's vast tapestry.

Wasteland.name: Wasteland
Wasteland.flavorText: But heed, the last, insistent flare of the fire's dying plea.

13 Treasures of Britain.name: 13 Treasures of Britain
13 Treasures of Britain.rulesText: When picked up, bearer's controller draws a card. Teleport the Treasures to the top of a random site or void.

A Midsummer Night's Dream.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream
A Midsummer Night's Dream.rulesText: Mortals here are disabled and each give +1 power to all Faeries here. Dispel if there are no Faeries here.

Amulet of Niniane.name: Amulet of Niniane
Amulet of Niniane.rulesText: Bearer can't be targeted or damaged by magic.

Arcane Barrage.name: Arcane Barrage
Arcane Barrage.rulesText: Shoot X projectiles in the same direction, one at a time. Each deals 1 damage.

Archimago.name: Archimago
Archimago.rulesText:
Tap → Play or draw a site.

Banish three magic spells in your cemetery → Cast a copy of one of them.

Arc Lightning.name: Arc Lightning
Arc Lightning.rulesText: Deal 4 damage to target nearby unit.
Arc Lightning.flavorText:
Lightning obeyed olde Merlin’s command,
Justice conveyed unto noggin from hand.

Attack by Night.name: Attack by Night
Attack by Night.rulesText: Enemies drop their artifacts. Allied units strike first this turn.

Avalon.name: Avalon
Avalon.rulesText: Provides mana and threshold for everyone.

Babbling Brook.name: Babbling Brook
Babbling Brook.rulesText: Genesis → Until your next turn, minions are disabled while atop nearby sites.

Bailey.name: Bailey
Bailey.rulesText: Enemies can't move to here on the ground.
Bailey.flavorText:
While chaos takes the world around,
A wooden wall keeps safe and sound.

Ball Lightning.name: Ball Lightning
Ball Lightning.rulesText: Shoot a projectile. It deals 4 damage on impact, then changes direction. Its next impact deals 2, then it changes direction. Its final impact deals 1.

Band of Thieves.name: Band of Thieves
Band of Thieves.flavorText:
The darker the night,
the better to ply their crooked trade.

Beacon.name: Beacon
Beacon.rulesText: Genesis → Gain (1) for each nearby site with an enemy atop it.

Black Knight.name: Black Knight
Black Knight.rulesText: Costs (2) less to cast if you have more life than each opponent.

Bluecap Knockers.name: Bluecap Knockers
Bluecap Knockers.rulesText:
Burrowing

Bluecap Knockers’ site can't be moved, destroyed, or modified.

Blue Knight.name: Blue Knight
Blue Knight.flavorText:
In silver and azure armor adorned, the knight rode forth,
a noble sentinel, radiating strength and chivalrous grace.

Blunderbore.name: Blunderbore
Blunderbore.rulesText: Allied Giants banish the minions they kill to permanently gain +1 power.
Blunderbore.flavorText:
Blunderbore grinned, eyes gleaming in the night.
“Eat we shall, my brother, with relish and delight!”

Bog.name: Bog
Bog.rulesText: Genesis → Until your next turn, units are Immobile while atop target nearby site.

Bonfire.name: Bonfire
Bonfire.rulesText: Genesis → You may destroy all Weapons and Armor nearby.

Boudicca.name: Boudicca
Boudicca.rulesText: Other allies have +3 power while successfully attacking sites.

Bower of Bliss.name: Bower of Bliss
Bower of Bliss.rulesText: Mortals in the realm become Beasts and are silenced.

Briar Patch.name: Briar Patch
Briar Patch.rulesText: Whenever an enemy unit enters or leaves this site, it takes 1 damage.

Brocéliande.name: Brocéliande
Brocéliande.rulesText: Genesis → Untap nearby Faeries. Tap nearby Mortals. Give nearby Beasts Stealth.

Brother Knight.name: Brother Knight
Brother Knight.rulesText: Genesis → You may search your spellbook or hand for another Brother Knight and summon it here. Shuffle if needed.

Brown Bears.name: Brown Bears
Brown Bears.flavorText:
Travel deep into the woods and you’ll
find one of two things: peace or bears.

Burning Hands.name: Burning Hands
Burning Hands.rulesText: May be cast by an allied Mortal. Choose two different cardinal directions and deal damage to each unit at locations in the area of effect:

Caerleon-Upon-Usk.name: Caerleon-Upon-Usk
Caerleon-Upon-Usk.rulesText: Only provides mana and threshold while in your back row.

Camelot.name: Camelot
Camelot.rulesText: Unique minions cost (1) less to cast to nearby sites.

Cast into Exile.name: Cast into Exile
Cast into Exile.rulesText: Shuffle target minion occupying an allied site into its owner's spellbook.
Cast into Exile.flavorText:
“But as for your son, Sir Uwaine, I hold him suspect, therefore I
charge you put him out of my court.” — Malory, le Morte D’Arthur

Castle Haunt.name: Castle Haunt
Castle Haunt.rulesText:
May be cast to any Elite or Unique site.

Dies if it leaves its summoning site.

Castle's Ablaze!.name: Castle's Ablaze!
Castle's Ablaze!.rulesText:
Conjure atop an Elite or Unique site.

At the start of your turn, destroy this site, minions atop it, and Castle's Ablaze.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.rulesText: Give an ally Charge this turn.

Cold Iron Rod.name: Cold Iron Rod
Cold Iron Rod.flavorText:
If a circle is traced with iron, or a pointed weapon
is carried three times round them, it will preserve
both infant and adult from all unseelie influence.

Common Village.name: Common Village
Common Village.rulesText: Genesis → You may pay (1) to summon a Foot Soldier token here.

Coy Nixie.name: Coy Nixie
Coy Nixie.rulesText:
Submerge

Once on your turn, Coy Nixie may force target nearby enemy to take a step towards her. Tap that enemy.

Cursed Land.name: Cursed Land
Cursed Land.rulesText: Whenever another site is played nearby, its controller loses 2 life.

Dame Britomart.name: Dame Britomart
Dame Britomart.rulesText:
Lance

If Dame Britomart would successfully attack an enemy site, she may summon a Mortal from your cemetery to her location instead.

Degradation.name: Degradation
Degradation.rulesText: Transform a Mortal into a Foot Soldier token.
Degradation.flavorText:
“Why, without your arms and armor, without the trappings
of nobility, you are nothing more than a miserable man.”

Dirium Fomorians.name: Dirium Fomorians
Dirium Fomorians.flavorText:
They roam the lands of men once more,
for tribute and the sport of war.

Dozmary Pool.name: Dozmary Pool
Dozmary Pool.rulesText: (W)(W)(W) – Genesis → You may submerge an artifact from your hand here.

Druid.name: Druid
Druid.rulesText:
UPDATED: Tap → Play or draw a site.

Nearby allied sites have "Whenever an enemy enters here, it takes 1 damage."

Duel.name: Duel
Duel.rulesText: An ally fights target enemy adjacent to it.
Duel.flavorText:
“And there was the most mightiest battle that
ever was seen in this land betwixt two knights.”
—Edmund Spenser, The Faerie Queene

Excalibur.name: Excalibur
Excalibur.rulesText: Bearer has +1 power for each of their elements. If they have all four, they are also immune to damage.

Fae City.name: Fae City
Fae City.rulesText: Tap an allied Faerie here → Shoot a projectile. It deals 1 damage.

Fail-not Bow.name: Fail-not Bow
Fail-not Bow.flavorText:
No sooner had his fingers left that enchanted
string than the arrow struck its mark.

Feast for Crows.name: Feast for Crows
Feast for Crows.rulesText: Name a spell. Search an opponent's hand, spellbook and cemetery for cards with that name, and banish them. They shuffle.

Fields of Camlann.name: Fields of Camlann
Fields of Camlann.rulesText: (F)(F)(F) – Genesis → Each player chooses one of their minions. Kill the rest.

Fine Courser.name: Fine Courser
Fine Courser.rulesText:
Charge, Movement +1

May carry an ally.

Finwife.name: Finwife
Finwife.rulesText:
Submerge

Provides (2) for each nearby enemy Avatar.
Finwife.flavorText: Such a devoted wife, in fair tide and foul.

Firebreathing.name: Firebreathing
Firebreathing.rulesText: May be cast by an allied Beast or Dragon. Choose a cardinal direction and deal damage to each unit at a location in the area of effect:

Forge.name: Forge
Forge.rulesText: Genesis → You may pay (1) to conjure a Lance token here.

Fourberie Knot.name: Fourberie Knot
Fourberie Knot.rulesText: Bearer minion takes no damage from units with 4 or more power, and is also a Faerie.

Four Waters of Paradise.name: Four Waters of Paradise
Four Waters of Paradise.rulesText: Sacrifice Four Waters → This turn, bearer's next elemental spell requires no threshold and costs (4) less to cast.

Frisky Red Squirrel.name: Frisky Red Squirrel
Frisky Red Squirrel.rulesText: Genesis → Take target nearby artifact that can be carried and hide it beneath this site.

Funeral Pyre.name: Funeral Pyre
Funeral Pyre.rulesText: Genesis → Banish up to three cards from one cemetery.

Giant Killer.name: Giant Killer
Giant Killer.flavorText:
If I have seen farther than others,
it is by sitting on the cheeks of giants.

Glastonbury Tor.name: Glastonbury Tor
Glastonbury Tor.rulesText: Only provides mana and threshold while in your back row.

Golden Harp.name: Golden Harp
Golden Harp.rulesText: Strike damage and life loss caused by nearby units is reduced to 2.

Goswhit Helmet.name: Goswhit Helmet
Goswhit Helmet.rulesText: If bearer would take strike damage, prevent it and return this helmet to hand.
Goswhit Helmet.flavorText: Strike me once, shame on you. Strike me twice, shame on me.

Grand Old Boar.name: Grand Old Boar
Grand Old Boar.rulesText: Has Charge if there are dead Squeakers.
Grand Old Boar.flavorText:
Bull-huge in the mists of the morn; what an impressive sight!
My quarry—with eyes ablaze for vengeance in the fight;
Running in fear, I glanced over my shoulder once more,
I tumbled, A final glimpse; the eyes of the Grand Old Boar.

Grievous Insult.name: Grievous Insult
Grievous Insult.rulesText: May be cast by any ally. Silence target nearby minion this turn and tap it. Draw a spell.

Grim Guisarme.name: Grim Guisarme
Grim Guisarme.rulesText: UPDATED: Bearer takes and deals double strike damage against units.
Grim Guisarme.flavorText:
An evil head it had, four feet large, no less, sharply ground,
and bound to the handle by the lace that gleamed brightly.

Guards!.name: Guards!
Guards!.rulesText: Summon a Foot Soldier token to each site near your Avatar.

Hamlet.name: Hamlet
Hamlet.rulesText: Ordinary minions cost (1) less to cast to this site.

Hamlet's Ablaze!.name: Hamlet's Ablaze!
Hamlet's Ablaze!.rulesText:
Conjure atop an Ordinary or Exceptional site.

At the start of your turn, destroy this site, minions atop it, and Hamlet's Ablaze.

Harassing Ruffians.name: Harassing Ruffians
Harassing Ruffians.rulesText: Units attacked by Harrassing Ruffians can't be defended.

Helpful Hob.name: Helpful Hob
Helpful Hob.flavorText:
"Up the airy mountain, Down the rushy glen, We daren’t go a-hunting For fear of little men; Wee folk, good folk, Trooping
all together; Green jacket, red cap, And white owl’s feather!"
— William Allingham, the Faeries

Horn of Caerleon.name: Horn of Caerleon
Horn of Caerleon.flavorText:
From the western hills, a great blast was heard and all at
once a wave of spear and banner poured over the horizon.

Hunting Party.name: Hunting Party
Hunting Party.flavorText: Among patricians, hunting vastly surpasses all of jousting, feasting, dancing, gaming, and polite conversation in money and effort spent.

Hyter Sprites.name: Hyter Sprites
Hyter Sprites.rulesText: Genesis → Name a spell. Spells with that name can’t be cast until your next turn.

Impenetrable Copse.name: Impenetrable Copse
Impenetrable Copse.rulesText: Projectiles can't enter this site from the outside.

Invasion.name: Invasion
Invasion.rulesText:
At the end of your turn, summon a
Foot Soldier token to each affected enemy site with no units. Lasts 3 of your turns.

Iron Man Talus.name: Iron Man Talus
Iron Man Talus.rulesText: Can't be disabled or moved by force.
Iron Man Talus.flavorText:
“His name was Talus, made of yron mould,
Immoueable, resistlesse, without end.”
—Edmund Spenser, The Faerie Queene

Joust!.name: Joust!
Joust!.rulesText: An ally targets an enemy they’re adjacent to, then they both take a step to swap places. If they pass each other, they fight.

Joyous Garde.name: Joyous Garde
Joyous Garde.rulesText: Only provides mana and threshold while in your back row.

Just a Rock.name: Just a Rock
Just a Rock.rulesText: May be cast into the hands of any unit already carrying an artifact to banish that artifact.

Keening Banshee.name: Keening Banshee
Keening Banshee.rulesText: May be cast for (0) if an allied Mortal died this turn.

Kelp Cavern.name: Kelp Cavern
Kelp Cavern.rulesText: Genesis → Look at your bottom three spells. Put one on top of your spellbook.

Kettletop Leprechaun.name: Kettletop Leprechaun
Kettletop Leprechaun.flavorText:
“‘My purse?’ said he, ‘’tis in her hand, That lady by your side.’ I turned
