Silver Bullet.rulesText: Bearer has "Tap, Sacrifice Silver Bullet -> This unit may cast an Exceptional spell from your collection."

Sinister Pond.name: Sinister Pond
Sinister Pond.rulesText: Mortals here may transform into Evil from hand by paying the difference in cost.

Sinterfee.name: Sinterfee
Sinterfee.rulesText: Genesis -> Target adjacent site is silenced and provides no threshold while Sinterfee is in the realm.

Sister Stefánia.name: Sister Stefánia
Sister Stefánia.rulesText:
Ward

Other nearby minions are silenced.
Sister Stefánia.flavorText: Poor sister, I fear her long-standing duties at the asylum have ...affected her.

Sjaelström.name: Sjaelström
Sjaelström.rulesText: Banish all nearby Spirits and auras. Draw a spell for each.
Sjaelström.flavorText: The storm howled in tongues, each gust crying a name long forgotten.

Skeleton Mage.name: Skeleton Mage
Skeleton Mage.rulesText:
Spellcaster

Genesis → May cast an Ordinary magic from a cemetery, banishing it afterward.
Skeleton Mage.flavorText: Its fingers still trace patterns of forgotten charms.

Slimy Mutants.name: Slimy Mutants
Slimy Mutants.rulesText:
Submerge

(3) → Transform an ally with Submerge into Slimy Mutants from your hand.
Slimy Mutants.flavorText: The little croaking Frog was gone, unconscious of the carnage done.

Slobbermaw.name: Slobbermaw
Slobbermaw.rulesText: Genesis → Sacrifice a minion or Slobbermaw deals 4 damage to you.
Slobbermaw.flavorText: Impicky and impatient. Watch your fingers!

Smite.name: Smite
Smite.rulesText:
May be cast by any ally.

Strike target adjacent enemy. If it's Evil, banish it instead.

Sold-out Cemetery.name: Sold-out Cemetery
Sold-out Cemetery.rulesText: Whenever Undead enter this site, push another Undead here away one step.

Sow the Earth.name: Sow the Earth
Sow the Earth.rulesText:
Conjure Sow the Earth to a single void square, playing your top site there.

This site provides double mana and threshold.

Sphere of Animosity.name: Sphere of Animosity
Sphere of Animosity.rulesText: Avatars here can't leave, heal, or be defended.

Sphinx Sarcophagus.name: Sphinx Sarcophagus
Sphinx Sarcophagus.rulesText: Genesis → Banish two identical spells from cemeteries to draw a spell.

Spore Spouts.name: Spore Spouts
Spore Spouts.rulesText: Genesis → You can cast minions with 2 or less power to any site this turn.

Stagecoach.name: Stagecoach
Stagecoach.rulesText:
Charge

May carry any number of minions.
Stagecoach.flavorText: The road is long, but the fare is paid.

Stargazer.name: Stargazer
Stargazer.rulesText: Genesis → Draw a spell for each minion in the void.
Stargazer.flavorText: The shapes we see in stars are more than just stories.

Static Servant.name: Static Servant
Static Servant.rulesText: Genesis → Each other unit here takes 1 damage.

Stinging Kelp.name: Stinging Kelp
Stinging Kelp.rulesText: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion at target site in this body of water.

Stitched Abomination.name: Stitched Abomination
Stitched Abomination.rulesText: Genesis → Banish up to three minions from one cemetery to stitch together. This Abomination has their combined power, but each part may be damaged and destroyed separately.
Stitched Abomination.flavorText: The sum of all fears, sewn with thread and blasphemy.

Sturmgeist.name: Sturmgeist
Sturmgeist.rulesText:
Airborne

Whenever an enemy casts magic, Sturmgeist steps closer then strikes it if adjacent.

Stygian Archers.name: Stygian Archers
Stygian Archers.rulesText:
Ranged

Whenever Stygian Archers kill an enemy, summon a Skeleton token where it died.

Survivors of Serava.name: Survivors of Serava
Survivors of Serava.rulesText: At the end of your turn, if no enemies are nearby, this gains Stealth.
Survivors of Serava.flavorText: The snow buries their road, their names, their regrets.

Symmetric Suffering.name: Symmetric Suffering
Symmetric Suffering.rulesText: Sacrifice up to one minion, artifact, and aura. Your opponent must sacrifice the same.

Tabula Rasa.name: Tabula Rasa
Tabula Rasa.rulesText:
May be cast to any minion.

Bearer is silenced, can't be modified otherwise, and can't drop Tabula Rasa.

Temple of Moloch.name: Temple of Moloch
Temple of Moloch.rulesText: Once on each player's turn, they may sacrifice a minion here to gain (2).

Ten-tonne Slug.name: Ten-tonne Slug
Ten-tonne Slug.flavorText:
It bade no roar, but crept as stone
Of chiliad winters heaped as one
Wrothe belly o'er burg, bosk, and bone
'Til Time herself was unbegun

The Apex of Babel.name: The Apex of Babel
The Apex of Babel.rulesText: When the Tower of Babel is built, draw a spell, then you may cast a spell for free.

The Base of Babel.name: The Base of Babel
The Base of Babel.rulesText: You may build The Tower of Babel by playing The Apex of Babel atop this.

The Doom of Dilmun.name: The Doom of Dilmun
The Doom of Dilmun.rulesText:
Burrowing, Submerge, Voidwalk

Can't be banished, destroyed, or modified.

The Empyrean.name: The Empyrean
The Empyrean.rulesText: Provides (A)(E)(F)(W) if you control a nearby Angel or Ward.

The Flood.name: The Flood
The Flood.rulesText: Permanently flood the entire realm, including voids. Submerge everything except one minion of each type.

The Hexham Haunts.name: The Hexham Haunts
The Hexham Haunts.rulesText:
Airborne, Burrowing

Must be cast burrowed, but may be cast from the cemetery.

The Inquisition.name: The Inquisition
The Inquisition.rulesText:
When an opponent can see this card in your hand or spellbook, you may summon it.

Genesis → Target opponent reveals their hand. You may banish a card from it.

The Malleus Maleficarum.name: The Malleus Maleficarum
The Malleus Maleficarum.rulesText: Once on your turn, bearer may cast a magic from your collection that targets an enemy Spellcaster, or their location or site.
The Malleus Maleficarum.flavorText: Nunquam faciendum est malum ut bonum inde eueniat.

The Manor at Daperyll Hill.name: The Manor at Daperyll Hill
The Manor at Daperyll Hill.rulesText: (A)(A)(A)(A) — Once on your turn, this may deal 3 damage to target enemy here to heal you 3.

The Pallid Bust.name: The Pallid Bust
The Pallid Bust.rulesText:
Genesis → Banish a dead minion.

Minion bearer has the banished minion's printed types and abilities.

The Rack.name: The Rack
The Rack.rulesText: Whenever the bearer strikes an Avatar, stretch them so that they also occupy another adjacent location. Then they lose 1 life for each location they occupy.

Thing in the Ice.name: Thing in the Ice
Thing in the Ice.rulesText: Genesis → Disabled for three of your turns. Can't be targeted or damaged by magic until the ice melts.

Thin Ice.name: Thin Ice
Thin Ice.rulesText: At the end of your turn, if minions atop this site total 5 or more power, submerge them.

Those Who Linger.name: Those Who Linger
Those Who Linger.rulesText: Deathrite → Summon a Ghoul from your collection to this site. It has "Deathrite → Summon a Skeleton token to this site."
Those Who Linger.flavorText: Fewer and fewer answer the call, but still they abide

Thumb Screws.name: Thumb Screws
Thumb Screws.rulesText: Whenever a nearby Avatar casts a spell, they lose life equal to the number of spells they've cast this turn.

Tombstone Wardens.name: Tombstone Wardens
Tombstone Wardens.rulesText: During your opponent's turn, this is a 5 power Angel Automaton with Airborne.

Toolbox.name: Toolbox
Toolbox.rulesText: Sacrifice → Bearer may cast an Ordinary spell from your collection.

Torch and Pitchfork.name: Torch and Pitchfork
Torch and Pitchfork.rulesText: Ordinary bearer has "Nearby Ordinary allies have +1 power."
Torch and Pitchfork.flavorText: Fire. Steel. And someone to blame.

Torrid Omphalos.name: Torrid Omphalos
Torrid Omphalos.rulesText:
Earth and Fire Spellcaster

At the end of your turn, this Omphalos draws a spell, which only it can cast. Minions it casts must be summoned here.

Town Priest.name: Town Priest
Town Priest.rulesText: Genesis → Return target adjacent Evil minion to its owner's hand.
Town Priest.flavorText: His hand may tremble, but not his conviction.

Trade Encampment.name: Trade Encampment
Trade Encampment.rulesText: Genesis → You may trade an artifact in your hand with one of equal rarity from your collection

Trial by Fire.name: Trial by Fire
Trial by Fire.rulesText:
May be cast by any ally.

Deal 3 damage to target minion nearby.
Trial by Fire.flavorText: The tongues of flame sing truer than the tongues of witches!

Trial by Water.name: Trial by Water
Trial by Water.rulesText: An ally submerges target minion it's nearby.
Trial by Water.flavorText: In silence she sank, and the town was satisfied.

Troubled Town.name: Troubled Town
Troubled Town.rulesText: Genesis → You may cast a Townsfolk from your collection to this site.

Undead Ambush.name: Undead Ambush
Undead Ambush.rulesText: Summon a Skeleton token to each other site adjacent to target enemy.
Undead Ambush.flavorText: Shortcuts through graveyards never end well.

Undesirables.name: Undesirables
Undesirables.rulesText:
Burrowing

Allies can't enter this site.
Undesirables.flavorText: Too broken to rule, too crude to serve, they linger.

Vampire Bats.name: Vampire Bats
Vampire Bats.rulesText:
Airborne

Vampire Bats' strike damage against units heals you.

Vandal Imp.name: Vandal Imp
Vandal Imp.flavorText: Imps perfect both plausible deniability and implausible destruction.

Varistus the Evictor.name: Varistus the Evictor
Varistus the Evictor.rulesText:
Voidwalk

Whenever Varistus enters a void location, he kills all enemies there.

Vast Desert.name: Vast Desert
Vast Desert.rulesText: Genesis → Deal 1 damage to each minion atop target nearby site.

Vesper Swarm.name: Vesper Swarm
Vesper Swarm.rulesText:
Airborne

Once on your turn, may fly to a wounded minion.

Vindictive Nation.name: Vindictive Nation
Vindictive Nation.rulesText: Opponent loses 1, 3, or 7 life respectively if they modify, move, or destroy a nearby allied site.

Virgin in Prayer.name: Virgin in Prayer
Virgin in Prayer.flavorText: In darkest shadow, the smallest flame becomes a sun.

Watery Grave.name: Watery Grave
Watery Grave.rulesText: Whenever an enemy drowns nearby, summon a Skeleton token atop that site.

Wave of Eviction.name: Wave of Eviction
Wave of Eviction.rulesText: An allied water site overflows in a cardinal direction, flooding sites there this turn and carrying away enemies one step at a time.

Weathered Trunks.name: Weathered Trunks
Weathered Trunks.rulesText: Must be cast to an allied site occupied by an enemy.
Weathered Trunks.flavorText: In a realm that forgets itself, the old roots remember.

Wiccan Tools.name: Wiccan Tools
Wiccan Tools.rulesText: Sacrifice → Draw a spell. This turn, bearer gains Spellcaster and their spells require no threshold.

Wild Fanatic.name: Wild Fanatic
Wild Fanatic.flavorText: His battle plan involves mostly yelling and gravity.

Willing Tribute.name: Willing Tribute
Willing Tribute.rulesText: Sacrifice → Untap an adjacent Evil ally.
Willing Tribute.flavorText:
Arms raised in solemn invitation,
Golfrida ruminated upon oblivion.

Winter Nymph.name: Winter Nymph
Winter Nymph.rulesText:
Stealth

Whenever a minion is summoned nearby, tap it.

Witching Hour.name: Witching Hour
Witching Hour.rulesText: Your Evil, Spellcaster, and Spirit allies gain Airborne and +1 power this turn.
Witching Hour.flavorText: Midnight bells toll—but not for thee!

Wreathed in Righteousness.name: Wreathed in Righteousness
Wreathed in Righteousness.rulesText: Ward all minions at target location. Then deal damage to minions at affected locations:

Wuthering Heights.name: Wuthering Heights
Wuthering Heights.rulesText: Once on your turn, you may fly a minion atop here onto a nearby site.

Yog-Sothoth.name: Yog-Sothoth
Yog-Sothoth.rulesText:
Occupies all locations safely.

Is banished without five voids.

Ignores the abilities of sites.

Young Master Damion.name: Young Master Damion
Young Master Damion.rulesText: Genesis → Summon two Ghouls from your collection here. They can't die while nearby.
Young Master Damion.flavorText: Family bonds persisting past undeath is rare, but it does happen.

Zombie Bruiser.name: Zombie Bruiser
Zombie Bruiser.rulesText: (4), Sacrifice a Skeleton token → Summon Zombie Bruiser from your cemetery there.
Zombie Bruiser.flavorText: About as subtle as a tombstone through a stained glass window.

Zombie Horde.name: Zombie Horde
Zombie Horde.flavorText: The living were as reeds before a fire, and the dead as ash upon the earth.

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
Skeleton.flavorText:
Behind the scenes, fighting the creeping dread
With packs, champagne, words that needed said.
A kind of hope, among those who could view
Borne on the backs of that small, streaming crew.

Foot Soldiers.name: Foot Soldiers
Foot Soldiers.flavorText:
"Farewell, farewell, O warrier brave,
Nobody can from Death thee save."

Foot Soldier (English).name: Foot Soldier (English)
Foot Soldier (English).flavorText:
"Farewell, farewell, O warrier brave,
Nobody can from Death thee save."

Foot Soldier (Saracen).name: Foot Soldier (Saracen)
Foot Soldier (Saracen).flavorText:
"Farewell, farewell, O warrier brave,
Nobody can from Death thee save."
